About.title: About Me
About.p1: I am a Frontend Developer with 1.5 years of practical experience in commercial and government projects. I actively participate in the creation and development of real-world projects, working in a team and taking responsibility for the frontend implementation.
About.p2: I have strong expertise in React, TypeScript, REST API, and modern frontend tools. I know how to navigate existing codebases, find and fix bugs, integrate APIs, and deliver features from start to finish.
About.p3: Additionally, I possess basic practical knowledge of backend development using Django REST Framework. This enables me to effectively communicate with backend developers and understand the overall application architecture.
About.p4: Currently, I also perform the duties of a Team Lead, coordinating the team's work, delegating tasks, monitoring the development process, and participating in technical decision-making.
